about: Which surface of each service the screen archive shoots. `platform` answers one question: can the service's core route (tools/phone-recorder/apps.json, core_route) be walked to the end on the web? mobile = the core route is only in the app (the site introduces the product); web = the product is used in the browser; both = web and app do the same job with similar screens, so the same screen type is shown side by side. `confirmed` is true only where a web walk was shot; the rest are guesses to be replaced by a walk. `web` records what the browser met on the date given: headless = Chromium with no window and its own user agent, headed = the installed Chrome with a window (allowed by the owner for sites that refuse headless, 2026-11-20). A 403 is recorded, never worked around. `reference` is the catalog id of the same service's DESIGN.md.
